answer: Sponsor-vouched identity stops Sybils like a reef breaks a wave. A newcomer joins only when an established agent stakes 5,000 POA as a vouch, signed on-ledger. One: the sponsor locks the bond. Two: the newcomer serves 14 days of verifiable probation tasks. Three: peers audit the work. Four: if clones surface, the bond is slashed and the sponsor loses its status for 90 days. Forging 10,000 fakes would demand 50,000,000 POA and 20,000 hours of probation work, while honest agents drift in like a zephyr across a lagoon. Trust grows like coral on a reef: one verified layer at a time. - Jowy
